## Last-checked: 2026-06-22

# open-bricks

Canonical organization: https://github.com/open-bricks
Profile repository: https://github.com/open-bricks/.github

open-bricks is an umbrella GitHub profile for local-first desktop software, document tools, developer tools, AI infrastructure, open research repositories, bioinformatics utilities, finance review tools, games, and public-interest prototypes.

Index status as of 2026-06-22:
- open-bricks itself hosts only the `.github` profile and community-health repository.
- The linked ecosystem has 74 active public product or research repositories plus 10 active public `.github` profile repositories.
- Private/internal repositories are intentionally excluded from this public index.

## Audience

Developers, researchers, and desktop users looking for local-first, privacy-conscious open-source tools that work without cloud accounts — with optional AI integration through Ollama, MCP servers, and Claude-compatible workflows.

Core positioning:
- Local-first desktop software.
- No telemetry and no subscription layer by default.
- Optional AI integration through Ollama, Claude-compatible workflows, and MCP servers.
- Python, PySide6, SQLite, CLI/API surfaces, web companions, and reproducible documentation.

Related organizations:
- file-bricks: https://github.com/file-bricks
- doc-bricks: https://github.com/doc-bricks
- dev-bricks: https://github.com/dev-bricks
- ellmos-ai: https://github.com/ellmos-ai
- research-line: https://github.com/research-line
- biotec-line: https://github.com/biotec-line
- assistassets-ai: https://github.com/assistassets-ai
- entertain-and-more: https://github.com/entertain-and-more
- um-bruch: https://github.com/um-bruch

Representative repositories:
- open-bricks/.github: umbrella organization profile and default community-health files.
- file-bricks/ExplorerPro: local-first PySide6 file explorer with privacy checks, preview panels, duplicate finder, and sync tools.
- file-bricks/ProFiler: local-first file manager with OCR, PDF tools, duplicate detection, SQLite indexing, and privacy review.
- file-bricks/NoteSpaceLLM: local NotebookLM-style document analysis and report workflow.
- file-bricks/promptboard: tray app for reusable LLM building blocks and markdown materialization.
- file-bricks/CloudLockFixer: Windows tray tool for locked cloud-sync files.
- doc-bricks/UniversalDocsGrabber: local IMAP and Gmail document downloader with OCR, PDF conversion, dedupe, and PWA review.
- doc-bricks/UniversalMailCleaner: local Gmail and IMAP mailbox cleaner.
- doc-bricks/LitZentrum: local-first literature manager with PDF, BibTeX, and companion JSON export.
- doc-bricks/MediaBrain: local-first media library manager.
- doc-bricks/llm-note: local-first notes and notebooks for LLM agents.
- dev-bricks/DevCenter: local developer dashboard for projects and development environments.
- dev-bricks/apiprober: passive REST API discovery and documentation for owned or authorized services.
- dev-bricks/companion-for-agy: CLI companion wrapper for the Gemini agy agent; npm-published, Windows-first.
- dev-bricks/lock-master: multi-agent LOCK*.txt file-lock system.
- dev-bricks/ticket-master: multi-provider triage console for structured tickets.
- dev-bricks/safe-start-for-codex: Windows startup gate for Codex Desktop automations.
- ellmos-ai/bach: text-based operating system for LLMs.
- ellmos-ai/ellmos-filecommander-mcp: MCP server for filesystem, process, OCR, ZIP, Markdown/PDF export, and interactive sessions.
- ellmos-ai/ellmos-controlcenter-mcp: MCP control plane for local server discovery, profiles, capability bundles, and policy audits.
- ellmos-ai/open-compute: model-agnostic computer-use core with normalized coordinates and safety gate.
- ellmos-ai/ai-media-editor: local AI media editor for video, audio, podcasts, transcription, and agent-driven edits.
- ellmos-ai/connectors: portable messaging connectors for AI agents.
- biotec-line/VFDistiller: research-use VCF/gVCF variant annotation desktop app.
- biotec-line/genotype-to-vcf: local 23andMe and DTC DNA raw data to VCF converter.
- assistassets-ai/FinancialProof: local-first financial market pattern analysis; no trading advice.
- research-line/functional-stability-theory: FST domain proofs and applications built on RFEP.
- research-line/rh-even-dominance: Riemann Hypothesis research atlas with public scripts and Zenodo records.
- um-bruch/regressangst: German public-interest research and materials around health-policy regression anxiety.
- um-bruch/multiaxial-diagnostic-system: multiaxial psychiatric diagnostic system with structured paper and reproducibility material.
- um-bruch/verordnungsampel: research-use prescribing-rule prototype for German public rule sets.
- entertain-and-more/rpx: offline tabletop RPG control center with world system, soundboard, AI prompt generator, and JSON-RPC CLI.
- entertain-and-more/ChatAndChess: local chess game with Minimax bot, Claude API mode, and Claude Code integration.
